summary: Clean pass. The .prettierrc config correctly maps all four AGENTS.md code style rules (single quotes, semicolons, 2-space indent, es5 trailing commas) plus sensible defaults for printWidth, bracketSpacing, arrowParens, and endOfLine. All 83 src/ files were reformatted and verified with zero prettier violations. TypeScript, tests, and ESLint all continue to pass. The worker followed the skill procedure faithfully, committed only relevant files, and left no loose ends.
